channel.title: Muhammad Basit Ali
channel.description: Open-source tooling for AI agent security and cloud security: Claude Code skill packs, MCP servers and linters, threat modelling, Semgrep rules and an AI agent incident dataset.

item.title: What the OWASP Agentic Top 10 maps to in 88 real incidents

item.title: Gating Claude Code skills in CI with a pull request comment
item.description: A how-to for skill-scan-gate: block risky skills, hooks and MCP servers in pull requests, adopt it with a baseline, and read its sticky comment.

item.title: The state of public agent skills and MCP servers
item.description: A random sample of 2,999 public repositories that ship agent skills, plugins or MCP servers, scanned and hand-checked. Five findings, with denominators, and what to check before you install one.

item.title: Agent identities are the new service accounts
item.description: AI agents run as app registrations, IAM roles and GitHub Apps that nobody owns or reviews. The failure modes, the controls, and an offline tool for them.
